A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have found that a FODO lattice with a phase difference of 90° is not the optimal lattice.

the available momentum space in a FODO lattice could be doubled without increasing the length of the cell.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the momentum space of a regular FODO cell is not optimally used, and the momentum space can be doubled by lowering the dispersion function in each cell to half its value, which is still positive.
the momentum space is not fully exploited in a FODO lattice, and the momentum space of a lattice can be increased by reducing the maximum value of dispersion function.
the available momentum space can be increased by using a new lattice with negative dispersion function.
